arxiv-2108-10691.title: Measuring chaos in the Lorenz and Rössler models: Fidelity tests for reservoir computing.
arxiv-2108-10691.creator: James Scully, Alexander Neiman, Andrey Shilnikov
arxiv-2108-10691.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by James Scully, Alexander Neiman, Andrey Shilnikov. This study is focused on the qualitative and quantitative characterization of chaotic systems with the use of symbolic description. We consider two famous systems: Lorenz and Rössler models with their iconic attractors, and demonstrate that with adequately chosen symbolic partition three measures of complexity, such as the Shannon source entropy, the Lempel-Ziv complexity and the Markov transition matrix, work remarkably well for characterizing the degree of chaoticity , and precise detecting stability windows in the parameter space.
